notes.title: We're taking part in GALM 2025!
notes.content: [p]Games are great. We all know that. But did you know they can also be great for your head?[/p][p]Running from [b]8–15 September[/b], to mark World Suicide Prevention Day, we’re proud to take part in [b]Games Against Living Miserably 2025[/b] - the event on Steam that celebrates how games can help us unwind, connect, and escape.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/GALM25" style="button"]Click here to visit the Steam Event[/url][/p][p]The event is presented by [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital?snr=1_2108_9__2107"][b]Curve Games[/b][/url] and the suicide prevention charity, [b]Campaign Against Living Miserably.[/b] By taking part, we’ve pledged a donation to CALM’s life-saving work.[/p]

notes.title: 🎥 New trailer for Off the Beaten Track!
notes.content: [p]We’ve just released a new trailer for [b]Off the Beaten Track[/b]![/p][previewyoutube="7rXT0432l3U;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This is the first full trailer after our announcement, and it highlights the progress we’ve made since then:[/p][list][*][p]updated visuals of all arenas[/p][/*][*][p]added new arenas[/p][/*][*][p]improved animations[/p][/*][*][p]updated game UI[/p][/*][*][p]added new mechanics and effects[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope this gives you a clearer picture of where the game is heading.[/p][p][/p][p] 👉 Check out the new trailer and add [b]Off the Beaten Track[/b] to your [b]wishlist[/b]![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3752960/Off_the_Beaten_Track"][/dynamiclink][/p]
